messages.subject: completely wrong values in facet_grid
parts:
Hey Guys,

I have a problem concerning facet_grid (and facet_wrap) or I just didn't understand, what I did wrong.
My problem is not similar to the slight mismatches some people are reporting. It's just wrong.

This is it:
For parameter 1 being "dünn" and parameter 2 being "oPl" (top row, right graph) the highest value in the input data is 4.95
which is in contrast to the graph:
code is +geom_boxplot()+facet_grid(Parameter1~Parameter2)

if I do exactly opposite around, meaning: +geom_boxplot()+facet_grid(Parameter2~Parameter1)

the values are correct.

Is anybody able to explain, what I did wrong? By the way, it's the same with facet_wrap and with geom_point() instead of boxplot.

Christian

example, though, it's impossible to know for sure; please post simple
data+code demonstrating this problem if you'd like more useful help.
